resources.string:
1. Make sure the sending device and the TV are on the same local network
2. Open the casting app on the sender
3. Scan for and select this device
4. Start casting
Runs in the background after the TV turns on, without opening this app. Some TVs also require allowing auto-start for this app in system settings.
Return to this app after casting
Stops on this settings page instead of going back to the TV home screen when you stop casting. Useful when you want to change settings right after a session.
Waiting for a network address. Check the network connection.
Receiver service is running. Waiting for a connection.
Receiver service is stopped. Reopen the app to retry.
Miracast discovery configured. On Windows press Win+K; on Android open wireless display. Discovery also depends on the device driver.
System Wi-Fi Display is enabled. If the device is missing from Win+K, open the system screen mirroring receiver and try again; this switch alone does not confirm receiving support.

Windows / Android screen mirroring is unavailable: root access was not granted. If this device has a system screen mirroring receiver, enable it first; otherwise root is required to enable discovery. AirPlay, DLNA and VLC Cast can still be used.

Windows / Android screen mirroring could not be configured. Check system screen mirroring, Wi-Fi Direct support and root authorization, then reopen the app to retry. Please include ADB logs if it still fails. Other casting methods can still be used.
This device does not provide Wi-Fi Direct, which Windows / Android screen mirroring requires. Use AirPlay, DLNA or VLC Cast.
Windows / Android screen mirroring needs the Nearby devices or Location permission. Grant it in system app settings and reopen the app.
Windows / Android screen mirroring needs Wi-Fi Direct. Enable Wi-Fi and reopen the app; an Ethernet connection alone is not enough.
Location permission not granted. Windows wireless casting is unavailable.

When this app is not open (for example after auto-start on boot, or after returning to the home screen), the system blocks the cast screen from appearing, so casting seems to do nothing.\n\nPlease enable this permission for the app on the next settings page.
This device has no such settings page. Run via adb: appops set %s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Subtitles follow the media\'s subtitle tracks automatically
Keeps the cast receiver service running
Waiting for AirPlay / DLNA / Miracast connections
Cast+ is off. Enable it to test wireless projection from a Huawei phone.
Cast+ requires Android 6 or later and an ARM device.
Cast+ needs Location and, on Android 13+, Nearby devices permission. Grant them and reopen the app.
Cast+ receiver ready. On the Huawei phone, open wireless projection.
Cast+ is waiting for connection confirmation or a PIN.
Huawei Cast+ is displaying the phone screen.
Cast+ could not start or the connection failed. Turn Cast+ off and on to retry; include receiver ADB logs if it still fails.
%1$s wants to connect using Huawei Cast+.
Enter this PIN on the phone: %1$s
Choose subtitles on the sending device.
